en: Vintage black-and-white (sepia-toned) postcard view of a small European town in a valley. A large hilltop castle complex with a tall tower dominates the left side, overlooking clustered houses, narrow streets, and a winding road or rail line through the valley. Forested hills surround the settlement. The word "Weesenstein." is printed in red at the top left, and fine red vertical printer's text appears along the right edge.
